_meta.description: Mapping from Figma componentId to TiComponents (or Element Plus fallback). Keyed by Figma componentId (stable across renames). When the MCP serves a Figma node tree, it looks up each INSTANCE's componentId here and injects a `tiComponent` field into the simplified JSON. Entries with `tiComponent: null` and `gap: true` are unresolved — the LLM must declare them as unmapped and not silently hand-roll equivalents.
_meta.fallbackRule: If a Figma component is a basic/atomic UI primitive (Button, Checkbox, Radio, Input, etc.) and TiComponents catalog has no Ti* equivalent, fall back to the matching Element Plus basic component (el-button, el-checkbox, el-radio, el-input). The Element Plus 回退对照表 in the skill is a partial list; this rule generalizes it.

legend.tiComponent: Target component name (Ti* or el-*). null = unresolved gap.
legend.gap: true = unresolved, must surface to LLM as unmapped.
legend.internal: true = nested inside another instance, do not render separately.
legend.variantToProps: Figma variant name -> target component props (merged when instance has multiple variants set).
legend.nameHints: Figma instance names this componentId has been seen under.
legend.docs: Relative path under ti-component-skills/ to load for API details.
